app.name: fastr
app.tagline: Send files of any size over your own network
notification.swept.title: fastr removed {count} unfinished transfers
notification.swept.body: They had been waiting more than 7 days. Open fastr to see what went.
pairing.title: Connect this phone
pairing.scan_instruction: Scan the code on your computer, or type it below.
pairing.invite_hint: Show the address and a one-time code for another device.
pairing.invite_step_address: 1. Open this address on the phone, or scan the code
pairing.invite_step_code: 2. Enter these six digits on the phone
pairing.invite_step_approve: 3. Approve the request here when it appears
pairing.invite_expires: Expires in {countdown}. A new one appears automatically.
pairing.invite_qr_alt: QR code for this computer's address
pairing.invite_no_address: fastr is listening on this computer only. Connect it to a network for a phone to reach it.
pairing.approve_question: Allow {device} to send and receive files?
protection.simple.label: Simple mode
protection.simple.notice: File content is readable by anyone on this network. Pairing and credentials are encrypted.
protection.trusted.label: Trusted mode
protection.trusted.notice: File content is encrypted end to end.
trusted.title: Trusted mode
trusted.what_it_buys: Encrypts file content end to end, and lets a phone write large files straight to storage instead of holding them in memory.
trusted.what_it_costs: It needs a certificate from this computer installed on each phone. Anything holding this computer’s certificate key could impersonate other sites to that phone, so the key never leaves here.
trusted.before_you_start: This creates a certificate authority on this computer. You can stop at any point, and the devices you have already connected keep working.
trusted.ready_announcement: Trusted mode is ready to set up on a phone
trusted.step_install: 1. Open this on the phone and install the certificate.
trusted.fingerprint_hint: The phone shows this when it asks. Check it matches before you accept.
trusted.step_trust: 2. Turn on full trust for it in the phone’s settings.
trusted.step_trust_ios: iPhone: Settings, General, About, Certificate Trust Settings.
trusted.step_trust_android: Android: Settings, Security, Encryption & credentials, Install a certificate, CA certificate.
trusted.step_open: 3. Open this address on the phone.
trusted.no_address: This computer is not on a network yet, so there is no address to open.
trusted.none_yet: No device is using trusted mode yet. Until one finishes these steps, its content is still readable on this network.
device.offline_hint: This device is not open right now. Open fastr on it, then send.
device.revoke_confirm: Remove {name}? It will need the code again.
device.empty: No devices found yet. Make sure the other device is on this network.
device.discovered_hint: These are not connected yet. Open one to see its code and pair.
device.discovery_unavailable: This network blocks automatic discovery. Type the address shown on the other computer instead.
device.manual_hint: The address shown on the other computer, numbers and all.
transfer.drop_files: Drop files here, or choose them
transfer.state.awaiting_acceptance: Waiting for the other device to accept
transfer.reconnecting_in: Connection lost. Trying again in {seconds} s. Nothing already sent is lost.
transfer.interrupted_hint: {transferred} has arrived and is kept for 7 days. Sending the file again continues from there.
transfer.resume_hint: This file was already being sent. {transferred} is on the computer, and only the rest will be sent.
transfer.via_computer: {name} passes this through without keeping it.
transfer.renamed: Saved as {stored} because {original} is not a valid name here.
queue.title: Queue
queue.one_at_a_time: One transfer runs at a time, so each goes at full speed.
relay.title: Passing through this computer
relay.explanation: These files are on their way between two other devices. They are held here only until they are collected.
history.title: History
settings.autostart: Start fastr when I log in
settings.running: fastr is listening on this network
error.unauthorized: This device is not paired. Pair it again from the computer.
error.pairing_revoked: Access was removed for this device. Pair it again to continue.
error.pairing_expired: This pairing expired after a long period without use. Pair the device again.
error.trusted_mode_required: This device only accepts trusted mode. Finish the trusted mode setup, then try again.
error.no_local_address: This computer is not on a network, so there is nothing for a phone to connect to. Connect it to your Wi-Fi, then try again.
error.would_downgrade: This device has been sending with trusted mode, and this transfer would not be. Its content would be readable on this network. Set trusted mode up again, or send anyway.
error.invalid_pairing_code: That code is not right. Check the code shown on the computer and try again.
error.pairing_code_expired: That code has expired. Ask the computer for a new one.
error.pairing_code_exhausted: Too many wrong attempts, so that code was cancelled. Ask the computer for a new one.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
error.replay_detected: A repeated request was refused. Reload the page to start a fresh session.
error.insufficient_space: Not enough space on the destination. {needed} is needed and {available} is free. Free some space, or send fewer files.
error.checksum_mismatch: The file did not arrive intact and was discarded. Send it again.
error.offset_mismatch: The transfer resumed from the wrong point and was corrected. It will continue on its own.
error.queue_busy: Another transfer is running. This one was added to the queue.
error.transfer_not_found: That transfer no longer exists. It may have finished or been cleared.
error.transfer_declined: The other device declined the transfer.
error.acceptance_timeout: The other device did not answer in time. Try again when someone is there to accept.
error.awaiting_acceptance: Waiting for the other device to accept. It will start on its own once someone there says yes.
error.awaiting_relay: The other phone is still sending this file to the computer. It will be ready in a moment.
error.relay_unavailable: The computer relaying this transfer is no longer available. The transfer will resume when it is back.
error.device_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the address shown on the other computer, and that fastr is running there.
error.invalid_path: The request named a location that is not allowed and was refused.
error.invalid_request: The request was malformed and was refused. Reload the page and try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong on the computer running fastr. Check its window for details.
error.network_lost: The connection to the other device was lost. It will continue when the device is back on this network.
error.source_unreadable: The file could not be read from the sending device. Check it is still there, then send it again.
error.destination_full: The receive folder ran out of space. Free some space, then send the file again.
error.destination_unwritable: The receive folder cannot be written to. Choose another folder in Settings, then send the file again.
error.abandoned: This transfer was not finished within 7 days, so its partial data was removed. Send the file again.
sweep.removed_partials: Removed {count} unfinished transfers older than 7 days.
sweep.expired_pairings: {count} pairings expired after a long period without use.
pairing.waiting_body: Go to {device} and allow this device. The request expires in two minutes.
pairing.rejected: The request was refused on the computer. Ask whoever is there, then try again with a new code.
pairing.expired: Nobody answered in time. Get a new code from the computer and try again.
pairing.abandoned: The pairing was cancelled on this device. Start again when you are ready.
pairing.already_collected: Another tab completed this pairing. Close this one and use that tab, or start again.
transfer.no_devices: No paired devices yet. Connect a phone first.
transfer.keep_tab_open: Keep this tab open while the transfer runs. It holds the files.
transfer.no_computer: Looking for the computer serving this page.
transfer.keep_screen_on: Keep this page open. If the screen locks the transfer pauses and resumes where it stopped.
transfer.none: Nothing yet. Send something from another device.
